systems.platform: Planned on X-Road (exchange), MOSIP (identity) and Mojaloop (payments), hosted at the Data Center National
systems.owner: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie numérique (MPTEN), with ADEN among the named actors
systems.tiers: National single entry point for the public, described prospectively; the criminal record extract (casier judiciaire) is listed among its services, answered by querying the Interior and Justice ministries' databases

note: The ministry's undated statement of the planned national digital architecture (published date is the retrieval date). It names no police force, station or station record system; its one term is the online request for a casier judiciaire through the citizen portal, which is the public class and gives no fact.
